Connecticut.covers: new and leased passenger vehicles and motorcycles
Connecticut.ends_when: age 18, or age 19 if still in high school
Connecticut.guideline_info: Commission for Child Support Guidelines schedule; worksheet on jud.ct.gov
Connecticut.model: income shares (both parents' net incomes combined)
Connecticut.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ calendar days out of service within 2 years/24,000 miles

Delaware.covers: new purchased or leased passenger vehicles only (used vehicles not covered)
Delaware.ends_when: age 18, or 19 if still in high school
Delaware.guideline_info: Melson Formula in Del. Fam. Ct. Civ. R. 500-509; online calculator on courts.delaware.gov
Delaware.remedy: refund or comparable replacement vehicle (consumer may refuse replacement)
Delaware.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ calendar days out of service within warranty term or 1 year

Maine.covers: new and leased vehicles; used vehicles still under new-car warranty also covered
Maine.ends_when: age 18, or 19 if still in high school
Maine.guideline_info: support table in 19-A M.R.S. § 2006; forms on Maine Judicial Branch website
Maine.model: income shares (both parents' gross incomes combined)
Maine.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for same defect or 15+ business days out of service within 3 years/18,000 miles/warranty term

Massachusetts.covers: new vehicles; used vehicles covered under separate Lemon Aid law (G.L. c. 90 § 7N)
Massachusetts.ends_when: age 18, up to 23 if a dependent full-time undergraduate student
Massachusetts.guideline_info: Massachusetts Child Support Guidelines; worksheet and calculator on mass.gov courts site
Massachusetts.model: income shares (both parents' gross incomes combined)
Massachusetts.threshold: 3+ repair attempts or 15+ business days out of service within first year/15,000 miles

New Hampshire.covers: new and leased (2+ year lease) passenger vehicles, motorcycles, and OHRVs up to 11,000 lbs
New Hampshire.ends_when: age 18, or graduation (or 2 months after turning 19) if a full-time high school student
New Hampshire.guideline_info: RSA 458-C; DHHS Child Support Guideline Calculation Table
New Hampshire.model: income shares (both parents' adjusted gross incomes combined)
New Hampshire.remedy: refund or replacement (via the state Motor Vehicle Arbitration Board)
New Hampshire.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ business days out of service during the express warranty term

New Jersey.covers: new and leased vehicles; used cars under separate used-vehicle warranty law
New Jersey.guideline_info: NJ Child Support Guidelines, Appendix IX-A of the Court Rules
New Jersey.model: income shares (both parents' net incomes combined)
New Jersey.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for same defect or 20+ calendar days out of service within 2 years/24,000 miles

New York.covers: new and leased vehicles; used cars under separate used-car lemon law
New York.guideline_info: Child Support Standards Act (CSSA); worksheet and calculator on NY courts site
New York.model: income shares (CSSA percentage applied to combined income)
New York.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 30+ days out of service within 2 years/18,000 miles

Pennsylvania.covers: new purchased and leased vehicles only (no used-car lemon law)
Pennsylvania.ends_when: age 18, or 19/high school graduation if still in high school
Pennsylvania.guideline_info: guidelines at Pa.R.C.P. 1910.16-3; online calculator available
Pennsylvania.model: income shares (both parents' net incomes combined)
Pennsylvania.threshold: 3+ repair attempts or 30+ days out of service; defect first occurs within 12 months/12,000 miles

Rhode Island.covers: new and leased vehicles (motor vehicles under 10,000 lbs); used vehicles also covered
Rhode Island.ends_when: age 18 and high school graduation, but no later than 19
Rhode Island.guideline_info: guidelines in R.I.G.L. § 15-5-16.2; Family Court child support worksheet
Rhode Island.model: income shares (both parents' gross incomes combined)
Rhode Island.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ calendar days out of service within 1 year/15,000 miles

Vermont.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later
Vermont.guideline_info: VT Office of Child Support (OCS) online calculator and guideline worksheet
Vermont.model: income shares (both parents' incomes combined, split proportionally)
Vermont.remedy: refund or replacement vehicle, at the consumer's option
Vermont.threshold: 3+ repair attempts (first during warranty) or 30+ calendar days out of service during the express warranty term

Alabama.guideline_info: Rule 32, Alabama Rules of Judicial Administration; Form CS-42 schedule on judicial.alabama.gov
Alabama.remedy: comparable new replacement vehicle or full refund, at the consumer's option
Alabama.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for the same defect plus a final repair attempt by the manufacturer, or 30+ cumulative days out of service, within 24 months/24,000 miles

Florida.covers: new vehicles purchased or leased for personal, family, or household use (including demonstrators)
Florida.ends_when: age 18, or high school graduation with support possible to age 19 if still in school
Florida.guideline_info: statutory guidelines schedule in F.S. § 61.30; administered by the Florida Department of Revenue
Florida.remedy: full purchase-price refund or replacement vehicle
Florida.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for the same defect (with a final repair opportunity after written notice), or 30+ cumulative days out of service, within the 24-month lemon law rights period

Georgia.covers: new vehicles purchased, leased, or registered in Georgia (cars, demonstrators, trucks under 12,000 lbs, motor home chassis)
Georgia.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever later (up to age 20 if still in high school)
Georgia.guideline_info: Georgia Child Support Calculator on childsupport.georgia.gov
Georgia.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for the same problem (1 for a serious safety defect) or 30+ cumulative days out of service in the first 2 years/24,000 miles

Kentucky.covers: new vehicles bought or leased in Kentucky (excludes used/subsequent purchasers, motorhomes, motorcycles)
Kentucky.ends_when: age 18, or through the school year in which the child turns 19 if still in high school
Kentucky.guideline_info: guidelines table in KRS 403.212; state online estimator
Kentucky.remedy: repurchase (refund of price) or replacement with a comparable vehicle
Kentucky.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for the same nonconformity or 30+ calendar days out of service in the first 12 months/12,000 miles

Maryland.covers: new vehicles purchased or leased in Maryland (cars, trucks, motorcycles)
Maryland.ends_when: age 18, or 19/graduation if still in high school
Maryland.guideline_info: guidelines in Md. Code, Fam. Law § 12-204; fillable worksheets published by Maryland DHS
Maryland.remedy: refund of purchase price or replacement vehicle
Maryland.threshold: 4+ repair attempts (1 for brake/steering failure) or 30+ days out of service in the first 24 months/18,000 miles

North Carolina.covers: new passenger cars, pick-up trucks, motorcycles, and most vans
North Carolina.ends_when: age 18, or up to age 20 if still in primary or secondary school (graduation, leaving school, or age 20, whichever first)
North Carolina.guideline_info: child support guidelines published by NC courts (form AOC-A-162), available on nccourts.gov
North Carolina.remedy: comparable new replacement vehicle or refund, at the consumer's option
North Carolina.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for the same nonconformity or 20+ business days out of service in any 12-month warranty period; defect within 2 years/24,000 miles

South Carolina.covers: new private passenger cars, vans, trucks, and motorcycles purchased and registered in South Carolina
South Carolina.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later
South Carolina.guideline_info: official online calculator from SC DSS at dss.sc.gov; statute S.C. Code § 63-17-470
South Carolina.remedy: replacement vehicle or refund of the purchase price
South Carolina.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for the same issue or 30+ cumulative days out of service within the first 12 months/12,000 miles

Tennessee.covers: new motor vehicles only (sold or leased after Jan. 1, 1987)
Tennessee.ends_when: age 18 or the graduation day of the child's high school class, whichever is later
Tennessee.guideline_info: guidelines under Tenn. Code Title 36, Ch. 5; state Excel worksheet calculator
Tennessee.remedy: replacement with a comparable vehicle or refund of the full purchase price
Tennessee.threshold: 3+ unsuccessful repair attempts or 30+ cumulative days out of service during the term of protection (1 year from delivery or the warranty term)

Virginia.ends_when: age 18, or 19/graduation if still in high school
Virginia.guideline_info: guidelines in Va. Code § 20-108.2; official worksheet forms (e.g. DC-637) on vacourts.gov
Virginia.remedy: manufacturer must replace or repurchase the vehicle (consumer may choose a refund)
Virginia.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for the same defect (1 for a serious safety defect) or 30+ calendar days out of service within 18 months of original delivery

West Virginia.covers: new motor vehicles purchased or registered in West Virginia (passenger autos, pickups, vans, motor home chassis)
West Virginia.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later
West Virginia.guideline_info: statutory calculation worksheets in W.Va. Code Ch. 48, Art. 13 (e.g. §48-13-502 worksheet B)
West Virginia.remedy: revocation of acceptance with refund of purchase price (plus tax/fees) or replacement vehicle
West Virginia.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for the same nonconformity (1 for a defect likely to cause death or serious injury) or 30+ calendar days out of service within the warranty term or 1 year of delivery

Illinois.covers: new vehicles only (purchased or leased; cars, light trucks/vans under 8,000 lbs, RVs)
Illinois.ends_when: age 18, or high school graduation/age 19 if still in high school
Illinois.guideline_info: income shares worksheets from Illinois Dept. of Healthcare and Family Services; statute at 750 ILCS 5/505
Illinois.model: income shares (both parents' net incomes combined)
Illinois.remedy: comparable replacement vehicle or refund of purchase price/lease cost
Illinois.threshold: 4+ attempts for same nonconformity or 30+ business days out of service within first 12 months or 12,000 miles

Indiana.covers: new vehicles purchased or leased in Indiana (under manufacturer warranty)
Indiana.guideline_info: Indiana Child Support Rules and Guidelines, published by the Indiana Judicial Branch (worksheets/schedule)
Indiana.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ business days out of service within first 18 months or 18,000 miles

Iowa.covers: vehicles purchased or leased (under warranty; excludes mopeds, motorcycles, motor homes, vehicles over 10,000 lbs GVW)
Iowa.ends_when: age 18, or high school graduation if reasonably expected before age 19
Iowa.guideline_info: guidelines in Iowa Court Rules; worksheets available on the Iowa Judicial Branch site
Iowa.remedy: replacement vehicle or refund of full purchase/lease price (less reasonable offset for use)
Iowa.threshold: 3+ attempts on same defect (with written notice for a final cure attempt), 20+ cumulative days out of service, or 1 attempt for life-threatening defect — within lemon law rights period (2 years/24,000 miles)

Kansas.covers: new motor vehicles only (sold or leased; 12,000 lbs GVW or less; original purchaser or lessee)
Kansas.ends_when: age 18, or June 30 of the school year of the 18th birthday if still in high school
Kansas.guideline_info: Child Support Guidelines and worksheet published by the Kansas Supreme Court
Kansas.model: income shares (proportionate shares of combined income)
Kansas.remedy: comparable replacement vehicle or refund of full purchase/lease price
Kansas.threshold: 4+ attempts for same defect, 30+ calendar days out of service, or 10+ total attempts — within warranty term or first year

Michigan.covers: new motor vehicles only (purchased or leased)
Michigan.ends_when: age 18, or up to 19 1/2 if still attending high school full time
Michigan.guideline_info: state publishes the Michigan Child Support Formula Manual
Michigan.model: income shares (Michigan Child Support Formula, MCSF)
Michigan.remedy: refund of purchase/lease price or comparable replacement vehicle
Michigan.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ days out of service within first year (or warranty term)

Minnesota.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, up to age 20 if still in secondary school
Minnesota.guideline_info: guidelines in Minn. Stat. section 518A.35; Minnesota Dept. of Children, Youth, and Families hosts an online calculator
Minnesota.model: income shares (proportionate share of combined parental income, PICS)
Minnesota.threshold: 4+ attempts for same defect or 30+ business days out of service within warranty term or 2 years; 1 attempt for complete brake/steering failure

Missouri.covers: new vehicles purchased or leased in Missouri (under manufacturer warranty)
Missouri.ends_when: age 18, or up to 21 if enrolled in secondary or postsecondary education
Missouri.guideline_info: Form 14 child support calculation worksheet published by the Missouri courts (courts.mo.gov)
Missouri.remedy: replacement vehicle or refund of purchase price (less reasonable use allowance)
Missouri.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ cumulative days out of service

Nebraska.covers: new motor vehicles sold in Nebraska (vehicles under 2 years old under express warranty; motor homes excluded)
Nebraska.guideline_info: Nebraska Child Support Guidelines published by the Nebraska Judicial Branch (Neb. Ct. R. Article 2), with worksheet
Nebraska.remedy: comparable replacement vehicle or refund of full purchase price
Nebraska.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 40+ days out of service during warranty term or first year

Ohio.covers: new vehicles purchased or leased (transferees during the warranty term included)
Ohio.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later, but no later than age 19
Ohio.guideline_info: official schedule in ORC Chapter 3119 (Basic Child Support Schedule), administered by county child support agencies
Ohio.model: income shares (both parents' gross incomes combined)
Ohio.remedy: refund of full purchase price or replacement vehicle, at the consumer's option
Ohio.threshold: 3+ attempts on same defect, 30+ cumulative days out of service, 8+ total attempts, or 1 attempt for life-threatening defect — within first year or 18,000 miles

Wisconsin.covers: new motor vehicles only (purchased or leased)
Wisconsin.ends_when: age 18, or up to 19 if still pursuing a high school diploma
Wisconsin.guideline_info: Wisconsin Dept. of Children and Families publishes the percentage standard (DCF 150) and an online calculator
Wisconsin.model: percentage of obligor income (17%/25%/29%/31%/34% of gross income for 1–5+ children)
Wisconsin.remedy: refund or comparable replacement vehicle, at the consumer's choice
Wisconsin.threshold: 4+ repair attempts for same defect or 30+ aggregate days out of service within warranty term or first year

Arkansas.covers: new and leased motor vehicles during the quality assurance period (warranty term, up to 2 years/24,000 miles)
Arkansas.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later; if still in HS, until graduation or end of the school year after turning 19, whichever is earlier
Arkansas.guideline_info: Income Shares Chart and worksheets at arcourts.gov
Arkansas.threshold: 3+ repair attempts for the same defect or 30+ calendar days out of service

Colorado.covers: new and leased vehicles (also certified pre-owned/used vehicles still under factory warranty)
Colorado.threshold: 3+ failed repair attempts of the same defect or 24+ business days out of service in the first 2 years/24,000 miles (2 attempts for serious safety defects)

Louisiana.ends_when: age 18; extended for unmarried full-time secondary students who are dependent on a parent, up to age 19
Louisiana.guideline_info: child support schedule in La. R.S. 9:315.19
Louisiana.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 45+ calendar days out of service within the warranty term or first year

Montana.covers: new motor vehicles only (excludes motorcycles and trucks 10,000+ lbs GVW)
Montana.ends_when: emancipation or high school graduation, whichever is later, but no later than the 19th birthday
Montana.guideline_info: Montana DPHHS Child Support Guidelines Worksheet
Montana.model: Melson formula (modified: self-support reserve, primary support allowance, then standard-of-living adjustment)
Montana.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 30+ business days out of service during the warranty period (2 years/18,000 miles)

New Mexico.covers: new vehicles only (leases not covered; subsequent buyers covered while the original warranty lasts)
New Mexico.ends_when: age 18, or until graduation or age 19 if still attending high school
New Mexico.guideline_info: state guidelines worksheets via NM courts/HSD (NMSA section 40-4-11.1)
New Mexico.remedy: refund (minus a reasonable mileage offset) or a comparable replacement vehicle
New Mexico.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 30+ business days out of service within the express warranty term or first year

North Dakota.covers: new vehicles only (excludes motorcycles, motorhomes, used vehicles)
North Dakota.ends_when: age 18 (can extend if still attending high school and living with the recipient parent)
North Dakota.guideline_info: ND HHS child support guidelines worksheet
North Dakota.model: percentage of obligor's income (rate varies by income bracket, 14-27%)
North Dakota.remedy: refund or replacement vehicle (leased vehicles: reimbursement of payments)
North Dakota.threshold: 3+ repair attempts or 30+ business days out of service within the warranty term or first year

Oklahoma.covers: new motor vehicles under 10,000 lbs GVW (includes lessees)
Oklahoma.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation; up to age 20 if still enrolled full-time in high school
Oklahoma.guideline_info: Oklahoma DHS guideline schedule (43 O.S. section 119)
Oklahoma.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 30+ business days out of service within the express warranty term or first year

South Dakota.covers: new vehicles only (excludes used vehicles, motorcycles, motorhomes, 10,000+ lb GVWR)
South Dakota.ends_when: age 18, or age 19 if a full-time secondary student
South Dakota.guideline_info: SD Department of Social Services online Child Support Obligation Calculator
South Dakota.model: income shares (both parents' combined net incomes)
South Dakota.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 30+ days out of service in first 2 years/24,000 miles (first attempt within first year/12,000 miles)

Texas.covers: new and leased vehicles within 2 years/24,000 miles (also used vehicles still under warranty)
Texas.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later
Texas.guideline_info: Texas Attorney General website has an online estimator
Texas.model: percentage of obligor's net resources (20-40% by number of children)
Texas.remedy: replacement vehicle, refund, or cash settlement
Texas.threshold: 4+ failed repairs of the same defect (2 for serious safety hazards) or 30+ days out of service within 24 months/24,000 miles

Wyoming.covers: new and leased vehicles under warranty
Wyoming.threshold: 4+ repair attempts or 30+ days out of service within the first year or 12,000 miles

Alaska.ends_when: age 18, or through age 19 while pursuing a high school diploma
Alaska.guideline_info: Child Support Guidelines Affidavit (DR-305) on courts.alaska.gov; guidelines in Alaska Civil Rule 90.3
Alaska.remedy: refund or replacement with a comparable new vehicle, at the owner's option
Alaska.threshold: 3+ repair attempts of same defect, or 30+ business days out of service within one year

Arizona.covers: new vehicles primarily; limited used-car protection (15 days or 500 miles after purchase)
Arizona.ends_when: age 18, or high school graduation or age 19 if still in high school
Arizona.guideline_info: Arizona Child Support Guidelines and online calculator on azcourts.gov; guidelines in A.R.S. section 25-320
Arizona.remedy: replacement vehicle or full refund of purchase price
Arizona.threshold: 4+ repair attempts of the same problem or 30+ days out of service within 2 years or 24,000 miles

California.covers: new and leased vehicles with a manufacturer's express warranty; also used cars still under factory warranty (demos, certified pre-owned)
California.ends_when: age 18, or age 19 if still in high school full-time
California.guideline_info: California Department of Child Support Services online guideline calculator (childsupport.ca.gov); formula in Family Code section 4055
California.remedy: replacement or refund of purchase price (consumer's choice)
California.threshold: 4+ repair attempts of same problem, 2+ attempts for a defect likely to cause death or serious injury, or 30+ days out of service within 18 months or 18,000 miles

Hawaii.covers: new motor vehicles purchased or leased (including demos); no used-car lemon law
Hawaii.ends_when: age 18, or up to age 19 if enrolled full-time in school
Hawaii.guideline_info: Hawaii State Judiciary Child Support Guidelines Worksheet
Hawaii.threshold: 3+ repairs of the same nonconformity, 1 repair of a serious safety defect, or 30+ business days out of service within the warranty term, 2 years, or 24,000 miles

Idaho.covers: new motor vehicles purchased or leased in Idaho; vehicles transferred while the express warranty is in effect
Idaho.ends_when: age 18, or high school graduation or age 19 if still in high school
Idaho.guideline_info: Idaho Standard Child Support Worksheet; guidelines in Idaho Rules of Family Law Procedure Rule 120
Idaho.remedy: replacement with a comparable new vehicle or full refund (less a reasonable use allowance)
Idaho.threshold: 4+ repair attempts of the same defect, 30+ business days out of service, or 1 failed brake/steering repair likely to cause death or serious injury, within 2 years or 24,000 miles

Mississippi.covers: new motor vehicles under the manufacturer's express warranty
Mississippi.guideline_info: guidelines in Mississippi Code Ann. section 43-19-101 (14%/20%/22%/24%/26% of adjusted gross income)
Mississippi.remedy: replacement with a comparable vehicle or full refund less a reasonable use allowance (20 cents per mile), at the consumer's option
Mississippi.threshold: 3+ repair attempts of the same nonconformity or 15+ working days out of service within the warranty term or one year

Nevada.covers: new and used vehicles still covered by the manufacturer's express warranty
Nevada.ends_when: first day of the month after age 18, or 19 if still in high school
Nevada.guideline_info: Nevada Child Support Guidelines Calculator (selfhelp.nvcourts.gov); tiered formula in NAC 425
Nevada.remedy: replacement or repurchase of the vehicle
Nevada.threshold: 4+ repair attempts of the same nonconformity or 30+ calendar days out of service within the express warranty or one year

Oregon.covers: new motor vehicles (and new travel trailers) purchased or leased in Oregon; not used vehicles
Oregon.ends_when: age 18, or up to age 21 if attending school
Oregon.guideline_info: Oregon Department of Justice child support calculator; guidelines in OAR 137-050-0700 through 0765
Oregon.remedy: replacement with a new motor vehicle or full refund of purchase or lease price (less a use allowance)
Oregon.threshold: 3+ repair attempts, 30+ calendar days out of service, or 1 repair attempt on a defect likely to cause death or serious injury, within 2 years or 24,000 miles

Utah.covers: new motor vehicles (New Motor Vehicle Warranties Act)
Utah.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later
Utah.guideline_info: online child support calculator on the Utah courts/DHS website; guidelines in Utah Code Title 81, chapter 6
Utah.remedy: replacement or repurchase of the vehicle
Utah.threshold: 4+ repair attempts of the same defect or 30+ business days out of service within the express warranty term or one year

Washington.covers: new vehicles purchased or leased in Washington, including vehicles bought with under 24,000 miles; not used vehicles
Washington.ends_when: age 18 or high school graduation, whichever is later (court may order post-secondary support)
Washington.guideline_info: Washington State Child Support Schedule worksheets on courts.wa.gov
Washington.remedy: replacement or repurchase (refund) of the vehicle
Washington.threshold: 4+ repair attempts of the same problem, 2+ attempts for a defect likely to cause death or substantial bodily injury, or 30+ cumulative days out of service within 2 years or 24,000 miles
